test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

One of the __most horrified serials__ of the Indian television industry was broadcast twenty years ago.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. most horrifying serials .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about a TV serial that was broadcast twenty years ago, hence the use of past tense "was broadcast".
 
• The phrase "most horrified serials" is incorrect because "horrified" describes a feeling experienced by someone, not an attribute of the serial itself.
 
• The correct word to describe the serial in this context is "horrifying", which means causing horror or shock.

Correct sentence: *One of the most horrifying serials of the Indian television industry was broadcast twenty years ago*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Horrifying:**

 
 
• **Meaning:** Causing horror or shock.
 
• **Example:** The movie was horrifying and scared everyone.
 
• **Usage: **Used to describe something that causes a feeling of horror.
 
 
 
• **Horrified:**
 
 
• **Meaning: **Feeling or showing horror or shock.
 
• **Example: **She was horrified by the news.
 
• **Usage: **Used to describe someone's reaction to something shocking or horrifying.
